game: God of War: Ghost of Sparta
target: 100% completion on the chosen PS3 Origins Collection route, spoiler-free

areas.name: Route and Save Setup
areas.location_cue: The Origins Collection menu, difficulty selector, save screen, and post-clear bonus menus.
areas.note: Chosen route: PS3 Origins Collection remaster through RPCS3 or original hardware.

save_backup.title: Create a rotating save set
save_backup.why: Fixed campaign objects cannot be recovered through chapter selection.

levels.1: Confirm the collection version before making completion saves.
levels.2: Play the PS3 Origins Collection release through RPCS3 or original PS3 hardware.
levels.3: Launch Ghost of Sparta from God of War: Origins Collection or the equivalent Saga entitlement. Verify the Legionnaire skin, Forest bonus arena, and Game Directors Live documentary are present.

levels.1: There is no chapter-select cleanup for fixed campaign pickups.
levels.2: Keep multiple manual saves and preserve one before each major physical transition.
levels.3: Rotate at least four slots. Do not overwrite the prior regional save until its pickup and chest sweep is checked; missing a fixed relic otherwise requires another campaign cycle.

levels.1: Clear data opens the large post-game economy and challenge layer.
levels.2: Finish the campaign once and retain the completed save.
levels.3: Save the completed file, return to the menu, and confirm Bonus Play, God difficulty, the Ares challenges, Combat Arena, Temple of Zeus, two first-clear costumes, and bonus menus are available.

levels.1: One costume is gated behind the maximum setting.
levels.2: Finish a complete campaign on God difficulty.
levels.3: Unlock God difficulty with a first clear, begin a fresh or permitted Bonus Play file on that setting, and complete it without lowering the preset. Save the resulting clear data.

items.label: Respect the Bonus Play Difficulty Limit

levels.1: Carryover is restricted by the difficulty of the completed file.
levels.2: Use previous upgrades and relics only on the same difficulty or a lower one.
levels.3: When starting Bonus Play, select the completed save and choose a difficulty no higher than that file's clear setting. Confirm the equipment, upgrades, and relic toggles load before overwriting anything.

levels.3: Meet the condition to complete every Temple purchase, open the Bonus Play or arena selector, choose the newly available appearance, and begin a controllable section to confirm its model and listed modifiers load.

levels.1: Clear data exposes a replay viewer.
levels.2: Open the in-game movie category after finishing the campaign.
levels.3: Enter the bonus video menu and open the in-game movie viewer once. Narrative entries are intentionally not described here; inspect them only after the campaign clear.

levels.1: The bonus menu retains a separate credits entry.
levels.2: Select the credits from the post-clear bonus menu.
levels.3: After clear data is saved, open the credits entry and confirm playback begins, then return to the bonus menu.

levels.1: Several galleries are split between the base clear and Temple purchases.
levels.2: Unlock and open every character, environment, miscellaneous, Sparta, and color-script gallery.
levels.3: Buy every gallery-bearing Temple node, enter each of the seven gallery categories, and page through every unlocked plate. Return to the category screen and verify none remains locked.

levels.1: The chosen collection includes an additional documentary.
levels.2: Select Game Directors Live from the Origins Collection bonus content.
levels.3: Open the collection-level bonus menu, start the documentary, and confirm playback. Its discussion is not summarized here because it may reference material outside the current campaign.

levels.1: A dense arena setup makes the game's largest combo milestone manageable.
levels.2: Use a durable enemy group and sustained area magic to raise the counter to 1,000.
levels.3: Configure Combat Arena with high-health or respawning enemies, equip meter-friendly modifiers, and maintain uninterrupted attacks until the displayed combo reaches four digits. Avoid finishers that end the target supply.
